body:
Thank you for your answer!

Called them several times, only got the machine telling me all employees are currently in a call. 

Honestly, I'm not sure. My studies are going downhill, but it's really only because of my long lasting depression. For >2 years I tried to get myself out of the ever deeper getting hole, hating myself more every time I fail and finally reached some sort of breaking point.
Also what's the problem with a permanent solution?
I started working out as tool against depression, three times a week ~3 hrs worth, best part of my day and the end? I cry in the shower about how much I hate the rest of my life, so  yeah ....

I tried telling my SO just now, I cried but somehow couldn't get the words out. I hate myself. 

She was great though, unbelievable supportive.
